_comment: Pierre code-triage eval. Each question targets facts that live in the Pierre knowledge pack (collection pierre_knowledge, indexed by the installer). 'doc' is a regex that must match at least one retrieved source path (grounding). 'facts' are regexes that must all appear in the answer. 'forbid' (optional) must not appear. Mirrors research/eval/questions.json. Nothing leaves the machine.
